# Brief

Hand-written, no brief: the v0.5 orders fixture, `vet-core`'s record and
`vet-lab`'s laboratory loaded through `gmctl load-data` with the purposes'
DDL, the centre's lab orders and their results carried by the integration
engine (`vet-lab-centre-orders`) and the critical calls' watch in the lab's
`pg_cron` (`vet-lab-critical-calls`), deployed by `run-short-test.sh`
(chunk 18a). Not a game.
